contentful_record_search.name: contentful_record_search
contentful_record_search.description: Searches for records of a given Content Model

query.description: The query formula to use to search for records. See https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/references/content-delivery-api/#/reference/search-parameters for more information

limit.description: The maximum number of records to return

skip.description: The number of records to skip

include.description: Number of levels to include for entries and assets. See https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/references/content-delivery-api/#/reference/resource-links/retrieval-of-linked-resource-links

select.description: The fields to return for each record.

aiMetadata.description: Lists entries of a given Contentful content type within a space, optionally filtered by a raw Content Delivery API query formula and paginated via limit/skip. Use to find or retrieve multiple records by criteria; pass an empty query to fetch all entries of the content type. Read-only and idempotent. Requires the content model (content type) ID; the query formula uses Contentful search-parameter syntax.

contentful_record_get.name: contentful_record_get
contentful_record_get.description: Gets a Contentful record for a given Content Model

entityId.description: The ID of the record to get.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single Contentful entry by its entry ID. Use when you already know the exact record ID and need its full data; for finding records by criteria use Search Records instead. Read-only and idempotent.

contentful_record_create.name: contentful_record_create
contentful_record_create.description: Creates a new Contentful record for a given Content Model

publishOnCreate.description: Whether or not to publish this record after creating it.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Contentful entry under a given content type, mapping field values to the specified locale, and optionally publishes it immediately after creation. Use to add a new record; not idempotent, since each call creates a distinct entry. Requires the content model (content type) ID and field values matching that model.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
